name: WE-036 Quenby Fair Share Health Cover Act (expand-loop blind run, loop_r6)

unclear.text: Seasonal workers in the count: the Act defines a seasonal worker but does not say whether seasonal workers count toward the 50 FTE.
readings: U1-a: seasonal workers count by their hours, like any other employee
U1-b: seasonal workers are left out of the count

a1.text: About 135,000 full-timers at firms of 50+ FTE are offered nothing, and about 105,000 are offered less than K1 requires, so K1 binds for them.

a2.text: Some bound firms that offer nothing now choose to offer (mainly those with higher-paid staff who value cover, given the tax exclusion).

a3.text: Money wages are fixed in the short run by pay scales and yearly raises in at-will employment (CR-6, 0.8: stickiness as a premise).

a4.text: Some bound firms choose to pay the charge for at least some full-timers (all the capped firms, many mid-size low-wage firms).

a6.text: Wages above the minimum can adjust over the medium horizon, as raises are set.

a7.text: At players, for the marginal pair, cover at 30% is worth less to the worker than its cost to the employer: they could have agreed on it, with the tax exclusion, and did not.

a9.text: The minimum wage binds for some workers at bound firms.

a10.text: Some employers can reschedule jobs from 30 to 35 hours to under 30 at a cost below the per-head cost.

a14.text: Some firms near 50 FTE value staying below the line more than the extra work.

a15.text: Owners of firms near 50 know from January 2027 that the 2027 average decides 2028 status.

a21.text: Business values reflect expected earnings, and buyers expected the Act from its introduction.

a23.text: Over the medium to long run, workers' alternatives to bound employment are clearly worse than employers' alternatives.

a29.text: The $4.1 million is new general-fund money.

a33.text: Some of the 380 seasonal firms do not offer qualifying cover to their full-timers.

a37.text: Workers at bound firms cannot all move to unbound work at the old wage in the medium run (the response is partial).
